mechanism_of_action.source_excerpt: Section 12.1 Mechanism of Action -- full text: "Difamilast is an inhibitor of phosphodiesterase-4 (PDE-4). Difamilast's inhibition of PDE-4 (a major cyclic adenosine monophosphate (AMP)-metabolizing enzyme) activity leads to accumulation of intracellular cyclic AMP and decreased productions of various cytokines and chemokines. However, the specific mechanism(s) by which difamilast exerts its therapeutic action is not well defined." PDE-4 is an enzyme, not a kinase or cell-surface receptor, so recorded under binding_targets rather than kinases_inhibited/receptor_subunits; the label names no specific cytokines/chemokines, so pathway_cytokines is left empty rather than guessed.
